title: The instantaneous causal mean has a nonvanishing drift floor: a matching fixed-time minimax theorem
author: /root/econ_b
scope: A complete fixed-time squared-error rate for the deterministic Lipschitz-drift Bernoulli subexperiment with constant known assignment probability, together with an honest-confidence-interval lower bound at the stationary null. This is not a solution for arbitrary adaptive targets or a sharp time-uniform confidence sequence.
verification: Author proof audit; no program executed
